svg.title: Tuvalu regional locator map
svg.desc: Base map by TUBS, CC BY-SA 3.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Tuvalu_in_its_region.svg. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Added dashed Natural Earth 1:50m Pacific Groupings v5.0.0 (public domain): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/ace5fed0eaf3c6c03c951e75b439ba8fffbc218e/geojson/ne_50m_admin_0_pacific_groupings.geojson. These are schematic island-group separators. Winkel Tripel projection, central meridian 150 degrees east, standard parallel 50 degrees 28 minutes. Projection-to-SVG: x = 1779.05843119 * X + 213.23550605; y = 267.16508772 - 1779.17029024 * Y. Original framing, land geometry, colours and locator markers retained; unused off-canvas geometry and Illustrator data removed.
